lesson.title: A place to keep a value

pages.heading: Variables are named containers
pages.body: A variable gives a value a name. You can use that name later instead of writing the value again. Strings hold text; keep them inside quotation marks.

pages.heading: Numbers can do work
pages.body: Store numbers without quotation marks. Use + to add, - to subtract, and * to multiply. An expression can use other variables.

pages.heading: Values can change
pages.body: A boolean is true or false. To update a number, add to its old value with +=. Read the task, try Run, and Submit when your result is ready. Run is always free.

tasks.title: Set your display name
tasks.prompt: Create a string variable named heroName with the value "Ada", then print it. The output should be Ada.

rules.message: Create and use the heroName variable requested in the task.

tasks.title: Charge the delivery drone
tasks.prompt: Kai's delivery drone starts with 3 battery cells and needs 12 to launch. Create battery with the value 3, add the missing charge using += or battery = battery + ..., then print battery. The output should be 12. A correct repair opens the courier lane.

rules.message: Start with a variable named battery containing 3 cells.
Add charge to battery using += or battery = battery + ... .
Print the battery variable so the charger can read its new value.

tasks.title: The fruit stall
tasks.prompt: There are 4 apples and 3 pears. Add apples and pears into a variable named total, then print total.

rules.message: Create and use the total variable requested in the task.

tasks.title: A little more energy
tasks.prompt: Start energy at 5. Increase it by 3, then print energy. The output should be 8.

rules.message: Create and use the energy variable requested in the task.

tasks.title: The key is yours
tasks.prompt: Create a boolean variable named hasKey set to true, then print it.

rules.message: Create and use the hasKey variable requested in the task.

tasks.title: Market maths
tasks.prompt: One potion costs 6 coins. You need 4. Store price and quantity in variables, calculate total = price * quantity, then print total.

rules.message: Create and use the total variable requested in the task.

tasks.title: What's left?
tasks.prompt: You have 17 gems and spend 5. Store gems and spent, calculate remaining by subtracting, and print remaining.

rules.message: Create and use the remaining variable requested in the task.

tasks.title: A village greeting
tasks.prompt: Set heroName to "Ada". Build a string variable named greeting using heroName so that it prints exactly Hello, Ada!

rules.message: Create and use the greeting variable requested in the task.

boss.title: Bring the data hub online
boss.name: The Firewall
boss.prompt: The Firewall needs two lines of output. Create heroName = "Ada" and coins = 10. Earn 7 coins, spend 4, then print the final coins. On the next line print Welcome, Ada! using heroName.

rules.message: Create and use the coins variable requested in the task.
Create and use the heroName variable requested in the task.
Update the coins variable using addition or subtraction.

hints.text: Start with 10, add 7, subtract 4. Print the new number first, then the greeting.
Use a print statement for coins. Join the greeting with "Welcome, " + heroName + "!".
